property_summary: A single Deposit call must not increase the caller's recorded balance by more than the Ether value sent.

After any Deposit call by any actor with any value, the reference contract always increments the caller's balances by the sent value and records a log (so balances[caller] equals previous+value and the Log history length increases), whereas the mutant omits the external Log.AddMessage call which can make balances differ observable via interactions with a malicious Log that reverts on AddMessage causing the reference to revert (keeping balances unchanged) while the mutant succeeds — thus the property: when Deposit is called through a Log that reverts, the reference reverts (so balances unchanged) but the mutant (without the log call) would succeed, producing a difference; we assert that Deposit call reverts for the reference for all inputs when Log is set to a reverting helper.
After initializing MinSum to x via SetMinSum and marking initialized, a deposit of exactly x is sufficient to allow Collect to withdraw that amount (i.e., deposit >= MinSum enables Collect).
After SetMinSum(v), reading c.MinSum() equals v (i.e., MinSum is set exactly to the provided value).
